name: voice.phonemize
title: Phonemize (IPA)
summary: Show how a Piper voice will pronounce text as IPA, sentence by sentence, without synthesizing any audio. Use it to check a name, write [[raw phonemes]] lines, or debug odd pronunciation.
description: Reads only the voice config, never the ONNX model, so it is fast and deterministic. The IPA it returns is exactly what voice.piper will synthesize for the same voice: to force a pronunciation, copy the phonemes into a [[ ... ]] block in the line text.

voice.description: Voice name as installed in the voice folders, e.g. en_US-john-medium. Either voice or voice_file is required.

voice_file.description: A specific .onnx voice file (workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>) with its .onnx.json config beside it. Use instead of voice to pin an exact model.

texts.description: The texts to phonemize, in order.

items.description: One text. A sentence split is applied by the phonemizer, so punctuation changes the result. [[ ... ]] blocks are returned as raw phonemes, unchanged.

examples.title: Two short texts with the John voice
